examples.name: Sample (constructed) — make_gantt
paragraphs: Four task bars and a diamond milestone on a month axis: five rows, the milestone with start and end both Dec. Design fills January to March and its end is Mar, the last month it fills.

examples.name: Sample — metro_s2_p18
paragraphs: Four task bars, one milestone and the revenue-service window on a quarter axis under two year headers — six rows in the chart's top-to-bottom order. The Sub Comp 2026 down-triangle is a single-position mark, so start and end are the same quarter; the double-headed RSD 2026 arrow spans the Q4 2026 column, both its edges in one quarter, so it too resolves to one period. A mark whose two edges fall in one quarter still gets its row. The dashed vertical line is a status marker with no label and adds nothing. The labels are printed in bold; the report headings above the chart are elided.

examples.name: Sample — guideway_schedule_p100
paragraphs: A schedule whose left-hand table prints each activity's ID, name, duration, start and finish: that printed table is the rendering, with its printed dates as the span of each bar, and the bar area to its right — year and quarter headers, bars, bar labels — adds nothing. The table lists 26 activities under group and crew bands. Long names are clipped at the edge of the name column and are written as far as they are visible ((cre on EGCC1270; on EGCC1350 the next letter is cut mid-glyph and left out). The first five activities are shown.

examples.name: Sample (constructed) — make_sankey
paragraphs: Every ribbon prints its value: four rows. Coal 120 and Wind 30 each feed a single flow, so their totals are already the flows' values; Gas 130, Industry 165 and Buildings 115 each join or split several flows, and their printed totals follow the table. The (TWh) in the printed title stays in the title. Node labels are printed in bold.

examples.name: Sample — llnl_energy_2023_p1
paragraphs: About 45 ribbons, each printing its own value in quads: one row per ribbon. Six of them, thick and thin, are shown; the rest of the table, the node totals that are no single flow's value, and the source note are elided. All text on this chart is printed in bold.

examples.name: Sample — material-flows-2020_p4
paragraphs: Nothing prints on the ribbons — every number is a node total. Where a node has a single inflow or a single outflow, its total is that one flow's value: fourteen flows are read out this way, in the same row shape as a chart whose ribbons print values. Processed material (7.98) and Total emissions (2.60) each merge several inflows and split into several outflows, so their totals are no single flow's value: they give no row and follow the table as printed. Backfiling is copied as printed. All chart text is printed in bold.
